stage0003_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Let's confirm the teams again.
　Team 1 is me and $$カナリア$$...」

stage0003_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Team 2 is Master Sergeant $$マオ$$ and $$ルカ$$.」

stage0003_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$マオ$$
「So we're the EW combo, huh.
　I'm counting on you, $$ルカ$$.」

stage0003_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ルカ$$
「I'll do my best, Vice Captain.」

stage0003_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Team 3 is $$ミシェル$$ and $$クラン$$.」

stage0003_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Same old combo as always, but
　let's do this, $$クラン$$.」

stage0003_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$カナリア$$
（Heh... quite the thoughtful call, for $$オズマ$$.）

stage0003_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Just when I'd shaken off one silent type,
　here comes another...」

stage0003_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Nothing to apologize for.
　Well... I'm a sniper, so I'll take assist.
　You handle forward.」

stage0003_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Quiet's quiet, but
　this one's just too tense in the shoulders...）

stage0003_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Last, team 5.
　$$アルト$$ and $$宗介$$.」

stage0003_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アルト$$
「Captain, a ground-type AS and a VF-25 fight differently.
　This pairing isn't efficient.」

stage0003_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$マオ$$
「Quit your bellyaching.
　By that logic, me and $$ルカ$$ are the same.」

stage0003_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ルカ$$
「True, if you pair an air-type with a ground-type,
　the air-type ends up fighting near the surface,
　so it can't perform at its best.」

stage0003_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$n
（I see...
　so fighting without adapting to the terrain
　is dangerous, is that it...）

stage0003_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ルカ$$
「But, $$アルト$$...
　transforming to Battroid improves ground adaptation,
　so that solves the problem.」

stage0003_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's not the point.
　I'm saying we should seek more efficient tactics...」

stage0003_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I'm not taking questions.
　Show me the best result you can in this situation.」

stage0003_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$クラン$$
「That $$アルト$$ guy...
　really seems to dislike $$ＳＲＴ$$... especially
　that $$ウルズ$$ 7, of all people.」

stage0003_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Knowing him,
　he probably can't figure out what that $$宗介$$
　guy's thinking, and it's driving him crazy.」

stage0003_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「As always, once he's set his mind on something,
　the guy just won't bend.」

stage0003_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$$キャシー$$, bring up the targets.」

stage0003_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Targets are the M6 drones, huh.」

stage0003_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「An opponent this weak, I could solo it.」

stage0003_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$マオ$$
「Don't get the wrong idea.
　This drill's about preparing for what's ahead.」

stage0003_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$オズマ$$
「That's right.
　Each team, know your roles, forward and assist...
　and choose what's best for the team.」

stage0003_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Teaming up on the battlefield
　means trusting someone to watch your back.」

stage0003_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Right, let's begin the drill.
　Each team, attack the target drones.」

stage0003_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$オズマ$$
「How was it, $$アルト$$?
　Did you get anything out of it?」

stage0003_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$オズマ$$
「We're soldiers.
　Fight together, and you learn to understand each other.」

stage0003_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$オズマ$$
「More so once you're trusting each other's backs.」

stage0003_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Can you hear me, Captain $$オズマ$$!」

stage0003_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「An unidentified unit is headed your way right now!
　I think they're probably allies of the ones
　who attacked $$第２新東京市$$ before!」

stage0003_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$オズマ$$
「They went out of their way to hit us here...!?」

stage0003_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$マオ$$
「Tch...!
　Looks like we're taking a surprise attack!」

stage0003_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$マオ$$
「$$ＳＲＴ$$ and $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$'s proudest top duo.
　Of course that's how it turns out.」

stage0003_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$$アルト$$ and $$宗介$$ are both trained soldiers.
　When it counts, petty feelings get pushed aside
　and the body just moves on its own.」

stage0003_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「They probably realized they're two of a kind now.」

stage0003_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「What're you so surprised for, $n?
　You want to be like that too, don't you?」

stage0003_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Not that the silent type needs to learn from $$宗介$$.」

stage0003_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$クルツ$$
「All right, good answer.
　Then I'm counting on you for forward.
　Can't let those two show us up!」

stage0003_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$アルト$$
「Heh... my body moved on its own.」

stage0003_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$アルト$$
「From here on, it's the real fight.
　I'm counting on you, $$宗介$$.」

stage0003_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We'll cover you from here too, Captain $$オズマ$$!」

stage0003_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$オズマ$$
「All right...!
　Skull Leader to all units!
　Let's make those fools pay for starting this!」

stage0003_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Confirmed, the enemy force is wiped out.」

stage0003_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ラム$$
「Still, these are strange enemies.
　Attacking a city last time, now hitting us instead.」

stage0003_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ミーナ#120$$
「So they've decided we're an obstacle to them?」

stage0003_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But even so,
　the force they sent is awfully small.」

stage0003_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Could it have been reconnaissance?」

stage0003_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If so, the question's when they'll hit for real...」

stage0003_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
???
「That wraps up the combat analysis...
　Troublesome bunch, though.」

stage0003_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
???
「Better to time our strike right
　than mass a force to fight them head-on...」

stage0003_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「When a team's two units work together,
　attacks like this become possible.」

stage0003_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Each team, cover one another
　and do what's best for the team.」

stage0003_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$オズマ$$
「When a team's two units work together,
　attacks like that become possible.」

stage0003_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Each team, cover one another
　and do what's best for the team.」

stage0003_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$カナリア$$
「Do you think $$アルト$$ will realize it from this drill?」

stage0003_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$オズマ$$
「If he can't manage that, he's still got a ways to go.」

stage0003_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$カナリア$$
「Heh... whatever you say,
　you do think highly of $$アルト$$.」

stage0003_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$マオ$$
「Really, pairing up two EW specialists
　is kind of a waste, honestly.」

stage0003_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Since this is a drill though,
　I'll get to learn $$ミスリル$$'s ways up close.」

stage0003_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$マオ$$
「Heh... $$ルカ$$'s such a good kid.
　A certain perv and a certain stone-face
　could learn a thing or two from him.」

stage0003_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$マオ$$
「Then big sis $$マオ$$ and the young master
　are going in with a combo attack!」

stage0003_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Me and $$クラン$$ don't even need to drill...
　we're already perfectly in sync.」

stage0003_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「If I had my way, I'd have paired with Boss $$マオ$$...」

stage0003_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Oops, drill or not, if I don't take this seriously
　the Captain's gonna blow his top...!」

stage0003_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「All right, let's go, $$クラン$$!」

stage0003_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$クラン$$
「Right! Let's show everyone
　me and $$ミシェル$$'s combination attack!」

stage0003_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$クルツ$$
「You're getting jerked around by the $$ジェニオン$$, $n!
　Skittering around like that's just in the way!」

stage0003_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$クルツ$$
（All fired up with nowhere to put it.
　This one might need someone to hold the reins...）

stage0003_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$アルト$$
「...why, of all things, am I paired with this guy...」

stage0003_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$宗介$$
「Don't waste breath talking in combat.
　You'll die.」

stage0003_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Like I'd die over a drill!」

stage0003_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$宗介$$
「A man who can't go full effort in a drill
　cannot go full effort on the battlefield.」

stage0003_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$アルト$$
「Fine, exactly as you say!
　Then I'll show you my full effort!」

stage0003_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$n
「$$クルツ$$, I need you to cover me!」

stage0003_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Got it!
　That's a sniper's specialty!」

stage0003_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Thanks to $$宗介$$ and $$アルト$$,
　looks like this one's learning to lean on someone.）

stage0003_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Some plan, from the demon $$オズマ・リー$$.
　Maybe I should hold off on hitting on
　Lieutenant $$キャシー$$ for a while...）

stage0003_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$アルト$$
「I don't need you to say it to know what you're thinking.」

stage0003_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$アルト$$
「Let's go, $$宗介$$...!
　We're finishing them off!」

stage0003_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Looks like everyone's mastered fighting in pairs.」

stage0003_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$正太郎$$
「All right, $$オックス$$!
　Let's take them down with $$鉄人$$'s combo!」
